property_description: Located approximately 15 miles from South Bend (Notre Dame University) and 110 miles east of Chicago, Elkart has a large population of over 52,000 people with a median age of only 33.4 making it one of the most desirable regional trade areas in all of Elkhart County. The immediate site boasts a strong tenant mix and attracts over 3 million visitors annually. The subject parcels are bordered by US Hwy 33 (Main Street) and Mishawaka Road which both have strong daily traffic counts of 17,200 and 11,500 vehicles respectively. The Mall is also just a 1/4 mile south of the US Hwy 20, an interchange that sees over 5,000 vehicles entering and exiting the ramp in addition to 27,000 travelers per day. Concord High School with nearly 2,000 students and faculty is a big draw for the site and located within blocks of the property. Concord Mall also enjoys strong adjacent co-tenancy including Big R Sporting Goods, Martin's Supermarket, Dollar General, and Goodwill in addition to national quick-service restaurant brands like McDonald's, Taco Bell, Burger King, and Arby's all within the immediate area. In addition to retail, the strategic location of the site between Elkhart and Goshen offers a plethora of scenarios for redevelopment which could include medical, office, or non-traditional uses due to the strong demographics and vehicular traffic of the immediate areas.

Hazelwood Business Park will include a combination of light industrial, tech, office, and retail/restaurant uses. Located on 82 acres, Hazelwood Business Park is centrally located in St. Louis County and offers immediate access to Highway 370 and I-270. The location offers convenient driving distances of 10 minutes to St. Louis Lambert International Airport and 30 minutes to downtown St. Louis.
